propositions: serverInfo 200 response does not guarantee that GreenHopper custom fields (Epic Link, Epic Name) have registered, causing timing flakes to be misattributed to image degradation
the harness waits only on serverInfo 200 while the probe waits on field inventory presence, creating a drift between two readiness definitions that cannot diverge
a system-only field inventory (zero customfield_* entries) following serverInfo 200 indicates the plugin has not yet initialized required fields, not a degraded image
the readiness gate must check field presence under a bounded budget and distinguish 'not registered yet' from 'not offered by this image' in its failure message
field initialization occurs when the first Jira Software project is created, not when the plugin starts, so a session-fixture field wait would deadlock before project creation
